game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor, a corridor of glyphs: the relic hunter must handle cursed statues while practicing lists. Core idea – Queue Line: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Glyph Corridor: a corridor of glyphs
core_gameplay_loop: In Glyph Corridor, repeat each round: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order. Each round, cursed statues strike the spirit lantern, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the queue_calm value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the spirit lantern from cursed statues in Glyph Corridor: keep the queue_calm meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: queue_calm drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Queue Line
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Queue Line' (Week 7 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Glyph Corridor'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_calm changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed statues in Glyph Corridor.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while queue_calm > 0.
